current_raw_input_shortcut: Windows appendPreviewSamples converts raw pointer samples directly to fixed-radius ARC_PREVIEW_PRIMITIVE_VECTOR_POINT values.
target_geometry_owner: Axiom runtime/ink vector geometry generator produces renderer-neutral filled variable-width geometry; Arc receives render-ready geometry only.
preview_flow: PointerSampleBatch -> BrushRuntime RB-V01 session -> common incremental vector geometry -> Arc preview payload.
canonical_flow: BrushRuntime commit stores existing canonical-compatible descriptor/source samples; replay regenerates RB-V01 geometry and Skia renders the same geometry contract.
arc_mapping: Extend Arc payload narrowly for render-ready vector geometry; no Arc smoothing, pressure, width, taper, or family evaluation.
space_diagnostic: Space will toggle presentation-only Arc/canonical diagnostic color; legacy runtime mirror, if retained, moves to another control.
